produced_files_verification.proves: recorded digest == stored blob at the reported revision
does_not_prove: that the working tree equals the compared revision

produced_files_completeness.note: files_on_disk counts manifest-eligible files; checkpoint.json is excluded because a file cannot hash itself. This is a same-process comparison, so it cannot detect a file created after generation - --verify-only re-runs it, and that is where a late file shows up as `unlisted` (exactly what happened when B.DR-rev3 wrote its record).
